tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Find a tool listed here instead of guessing its name, and get its definition. Query forms: (1) "skill:<name>" — a whole bundle; call list_skills for the names; (2) "select:name1,name2" — exact tools; (3) free text like "cancel run" — ranked against name and description. Non-billable.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Skill bundles: groups of the tools listed here that are used together for one task (diagnose-connection-references, build-flow, debug-flow, monitor-flow, discover, governance). Returns each bundle's name and one-line description. Use it when unsure which tools fit a request; tool_search "skill:<name

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a Flow Studio MCP bug or missing capability, append text evidence, or check your reports. Free and available even after quota is reached. Do not include passwords, access tokens, secrets, or full flow definitions unless necessary.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get the status and result of a long-running tool call. When a tool replies with a taskId and status "working", the work is still running on the server: do not call that tool again. Wait pollIntervalMs, then call this with the taskId until status is completed or failed. Free.

tools.name: list_store_flows
tools.description: [Requires Pro+ plan] List Power Automate flows from the Power Clarity cache. Optionally filter by governance flags (monitor, notification rules). Returns key fields including trigger URL, state, and run failure rate. Data is from the stored snapshot — not live from the Power Automate API.

tools.name: get_store_flow
tools.description: [Requires Pro+ plan] Get full details for a single Power Automate flow from the Power Clarity cache. Includes trigger URL, owners, state, run statistics, and governance metadata. Data is from the stored snapshot — not live from the Power Automate API.

tools.name: get_store_flow_runs
tools.description: [Requires Pro+ plan] Get cached run history for a flow from the Power Clarity store. Defaults to the last 7 days. Returns startTime, endTime, status, duration (seconds), failedActions, and remediation hint per run. Data is from the stored snapshot — not live from the Power Automate API.

tools.name: get_store_flow_summary
tools.description: [Requires Pro+ plan] Get aggregated run statistics for a flow from the Power Clarity cache: total runs, success count, failure count, success rate, fail rate, and average/max duration over a time window. Data is from the stored snapshot — not live from the Power Automate API.

tools.name: update_store_flow
tools.description: [Requires Pro+ plan] Update governance/metadata fields on a flow record in the Power Clarity store (description, business impact, owner team, tags, monitor flag, notification settings, etc.). Only fields provided are updated (merge semantics). Writes to the cache — does not call the Power Automate A

tools.name: list_store_environments
tools.description: [Requires Pro+ plan] List all Power Platform environments from the Power Clarity cache.

tools.name: list_store_makers
tools.description: [Requires Pro+ plan] List all makers (citizen developers / AAD users) from the Power Clarity cache.

tools.name: get_store_maker
tools.description: [Requires Pro+ plan] Get details for a single maker from the Power Clarity cache by their key (usually the AAD object ID). Includes flow/app counts and whether the account has been deleted.

tools.name: list_store_power_apps
tools.description: [Requires Pro+ plan] List all Power Apps canvas apps from the Power Clarity cache.

tools.name: list_store_connections
tools.description: [Requires Pro+ plan] List all Power Platform connections from the Power Clarity cache.

Returns { runs, runCount, triggerChecks }: each run has name, status, startTime, endTime, trigger name/code, and any top-level error. IMPORTANT — no runs does NOT mean the flow is healthy. tools.name: get_live_flow_run_action_outputs

tools.name: cancel_live_flow_run
tools.description: Cancel a currently running Power Automate flow run via the live PA API. Use after get_live_flow_runs to obtain the run name. Only runs with status "Running" can be cancelled.

tools.name: resubmit_live_flow_run
tools.description: Resubmit a failed or cancelled Power Automate flow run via the live PA API, re-using the original trigger payload. Discovers the trigger name from the flow definition automatically — no trigger name parameter needed.

tools.name: set_live_flow_state
tools.description: Start or stop the flow you name. Reads the current state first and only calls Power Automate if a change is actually needed.

tools.name: get_live_flow

tools.name: get_live_flow_versions
tools.description: List a flow's versions, newest first. A flow in a solution lists every published version. Any other flow lists only versions that ran.

tools.name: diff_live_flow
tools.description: Compare two versions of a flow. Returns the actions added, removed and changed.

tools.name: update_live_flow

tools.description: List Power Automate flows in an environment. Returns id, displayName, state, triggerType, and lastModifiedTime for each flow. mode=owner (default): flows you own plus flows shared with you (personal + team), with full definitions. mode=admin: all flows in the environment (requires an admin account).

tools.description: Read rows from a Dataverse table, SharePoint list, SQL table or Excel table. Read-only. Returns rows, columns and nextLink.

tools.description: Shows a sign-in card; the person signs in, or signs in again when expired. Flow Studio keeps the sign-in for later calls.

findings.detail: Description of "report_bug" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_live_flow_runs" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_live_flow" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_store_flows, get_store_flow, get_live_flow_run_error · Private data: report_bug, update_store_flow, get_live_flow_runs, resolve_live_parameters · Public sink: trigger_live_flow · Destructive: tool_search, list_store_flows, get_store_flow, get_store_flow_runs, get_store_flow_summary, get_live_flow_runs, get_live_flow_run_error, get_live_flow_run_action_outputs, trigger_live_flow, cancel_live_flow_run, resubmit_live_flow_run, update_live_flow, list_live_connections, test_live_connection, delete_live_flow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_store_flows, get_store_flow, get_live_flow_run_error · Private data: report_bug, update_store_flow, get_live_flow_runs, resolve_live_parameters · Public sink: trigger_live_flow · Destructive: tool_search, list_store_flows, get_store_flow, get_store_flow_runs, get_store_flow_summary, get_live_flow_runs, get_live_flow_run_error, get_live_flow_run_action_outputs, trigger_live_flow, cancel_live_flow_run, resubmit_live_flow_run, update_live_flow, list_live_connections, test_live_connection, delete_live_flow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
